title: Coherent carrier of an open section
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $E$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $U$ an open subset, and $s\in E(U)$. There are a coherent quasi-coherent module $H$, a monomorphism $h:H\to E$, and $t\in H(U)$ with $h_U(t)=s$.

source.place: First paragraph of Tag 01YB; Properties Tag 01PF and Cohomology of Schemes Tag 01XZ.

proof.text:
Regard the section as a morphism from the structure module on U to E|U.
Its image is quasi-coherent and of finite type, since the structure module is
quasi-coherent and generated by one. Every open in a Noetherian space is
quasi-compact. Extend this image to a finite-type quasi-coherent submodule H
of E by Tag 01PF. Tag 01XZ makes H coherent. On U the extended submodule equals
the image; the original section is the image of one, so it has a preimage t
in H(U). This also covers the empty open, using its unique section.
